question: A can complete a piece of work alone in 120 days, while A and B, working together, can complete this piece of work in 72 days. In how many days can B, working alone, complete this piece of work?
solution:
Given: 

A can complete a piece of work alone in 120 days

A and B, working together, can complete this piece of work in 72 days.

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

B alone can complete in 1 day is

1/72 - 1/120

⇒ 5-3over360

⇒ 2/360 = 1/180 part

**So B alone can complete the total work in 180 days**
